Glance 2026.09.20 improves Word, Excel, and PowerPoint previews.

- Show DOCX content sooner, then load the complete document while preserving the reading position.
- Improve XLSX responsiveness with background worksheet parsing, virtualized cells, and on-demand pictures and charts.
- Load PPTX slides as they become visible. Large presentations load embedded audio and video when played.
- Recognize Open XML documents saved with legacy Office extensions.
- Improve cancellation when switching away from a loading native Office preview.
